At each t<T compose the actual Frechet derivative of f with the supplied trajectory derivative.
Rewrite the resulting inner product with negative actual gradient as -norm(gradient f(Xt))² and subtract the constant minimum.
Apply existing one-sided Mathlib Gronwall on0T with delta=e(0),K=-2alpha,epsilon0; rewrite exponential normalization.
Use supplied global minimum for e(t)>=0, including endpoints.
